alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A kitchen. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes walks from the left toward a tall fridge, stops in front of it and its eyes go wide, a question mark pops up above it, it looks up and tilts, then it walks back to the left, its eyes turn happy as if it remembered, and it walks to the fridge again with the same wide eyes and the same question mark. At the end it narrows its eyes at the camera. The text stays: me walking into the kitchen and forgetting why.
